capability: Ask the model to draft the prompt first
title: Let it draft the cards first.

hook.picture: Close on a blank card; the whale scribbles a short line, deletes it, scribbles again, and sends; a pod answers a vague ✕ (copper chip).
hook.words: I never know what to write.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I never know what to write in the box.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: anyone new to AI at work

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three scrawls sent, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; three vague ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: One line in, one guess out.

stakes.body: Vague one-line asks get vague answers, so people give up on the tool or trust a guess.

solution_hint: Ask it to write the prompt first.

metaphor.body: The whale hands the pod its rough line; the pod sends back a stack of tabbed cards (goal, context, check); the whale fixes one and adds its facts.

steps.picture: The whale hands the pod its rough line; the pod sends back a stack of cards with coloured tabs: goal, context, check.
Push-in: the whale reads the cards and fixes one (the goal card), tab re-coloured.
steps.words: You read it and fix one card.

steps.picture: The whale sends the stack; the pod answers ✓.
The stack of cards sits labelled beside the pod.
steps.words: A prompt about prompts: a meta-prompt.

real_case.claim: Manu's storyboard method (Explainer Lab): for any stage, first ask the model to write the best prompt for that stage; the plugin does this with one command, /meta.

honest_limit.picture: The drafted stack looks complete but has no card for the fact only the whale knows; the pod answers with the wrong name, ✕.
honest_limit.words: It can't ask for what it doesn't know.

not_this.body: It drafts the shape. You bring the facts.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot on the same blank card: this time a drafted stack arrives; the whale adds the one missing fact card and sends; pod ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the blank card got a scribble and a vague ✕; the same blank card now becomes a stack of cards and a ✓.

end_belief.body: Ask for the prompt first. Then add facts.
